metadata.case_name: YIU YUEN YEE v. JOHNSON CLEANING SERVICES CO LTD

plaintiff.occupation_before: cleaner (or, according to the defendant, the foreman of cleaners)

injuries.description: small full thickness tear involving the mid and posterior fibres of the supraspinatus tendon; tendinosis of the anterior part of the tendon
source: A MRI performed on 30 October 2014 showed “small full thickness tear involving the mid and posterior fibres of the supraspinatus tendon” and “tendinosis of the anterior part of the tendon”.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of muscle or tendon of the rotator cuff of shoulder

injuries.description: full thickness tear of the supraspinatus tendon with moderate muscle atrophy and suspected superior labral tear
source: A further MRI was performed on 21 August 2015 which showed, amongst others, full thickness tear of the supraspinatus tendon with moderate muscle atrophy and suspected superior labral tear.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of muscle or tendon of the rotator cuff of shoulder

injuries.description: sprain of left shoulder (initial A&E diagnosis)
source: She was diagnosed as having a sprain and was given an injection and was discharged.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of shoulder joint

manifestations.description: reduced range of motion of left shoulder
numbness in left shoulder and left hand

losses.description: Residual symptoms of intermittent pain, weakness and stiffness in left shoulder with numbness in left shoulder and left hand.

comparable_cases.case_name: Lam Hing Choi v Yip King On and others
comparable_cases.injury_description: traumatic soft tissue injuries to shoulder and back; did not involve any remedial surgery; finding of muscle wasting so residual symptoms were more severe
